title: Pydantic AI Core Utilities
summary: This module provides fundamental utilities for Pydantic AI, including concurrency management, asynchronous execution helpers, prompt formatting, and deprecated callable handling. It also defines core concepts like `RunContext` and `PendingMessage` for agent execution flow.
